findings.desc: docs/requirements/decisions/decision-doc-promotion-execution-plan.md:44,56,169,173,436,619,629 still says manual/saved decision-doc edits trigger or are enforced by the existing decision-doc 3x2 quorum DONE gate. WHY: the implemented and newly documented policy makes direct decision-doc edits classification/diagnostic only; escalation is threshold-triggered via review_escalation_status. This stale operator-facing wording fails the docs acceptance criterion that no decision-doc edit is described as always requiring 3x2.

docs/requirements/decisions/three-round-two-host-review-escalation-execution-plan.md:101,112 says degraded fallback has two/both eligibility paths even though packages/main/src/core/review-escalation.ts:16-20 and packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts:245-249 implement three eligibility values. The same doc at 282,806,871 describes an allowed fallback reason as the enum, but packages/main/src/handlers/review-escalation.ts:56-66 validates enum eligibility plus a free-form reason and evidenceRefs/approvalRef. WHY: operator docs do not match the implemented eligibility contract and can tell operators to supply the wrong degraded 3x1 evidence shape.

docs/requirements/decisions/three-round-two-host-review-escalation-execution-plan.md:265-268 still says the current runtime may evaluate `changedDirectDecisionDocs || firstReviewRoundCountableProblems >= 2` until the implementation story migrates the existing decision-doc gate. WHY: the implementation is already migrated: machine.ts:420 and machine.ts:850 call evaluateReviewEscalation for DONE, done-oracle.ts:626 documents the first REVIEW round countable-problem trigger, and decision-doc-quorum.ts:44 reports classification-only diagnostics. This stale transition note contradicts current runtime behavior and can mislead operators into believing direct decision-doc edits still trigger an always-on DONE 3x2 quorum.
